description: Source code for the Student Leave Application doctype in ERPNext, managing leave validation, attendance updates, and holiday calculations.

classes.name: StudentLeaveApplication
classes.description: Represents a student leave application, handling validation, attendance updates, and duplicate checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the leave application, including holiday list validation and duplicate detection.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Triggers attendance update when the leave application is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Cancels attendance records when the leave application is canceled.

methods.name: validate_duplicate
methods.description: Checks for existing overlapping leave applications for the same student.

methods.name: validate_holiday_list
methods.description: Calculates total leave days considering holidays.

methods.name: update_attendance
methods.description: Updates or creates attendance records for each date in the leave period.

methods.name: cancel_attendance
methods.description: Marks attendance records as canceled for the leave period.
